description: Figure 4 is a line plot that compares the mean absolute values of model outputs before and after applying a gating mechanism. The x-axis represents the "Layer" number, ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Mean Absolute Value," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the "mean absolute value before gate," which remains relatively stable at a low value (approximately 0.03) across all layers; an orange dotted line for the "mean absolute value after gate," which starts at a high value (around 0.9) and decreases to approximately 0.44; and a green dash-dotted line for the "mean absolute value after average gate," which also starts high (around 0.9) and decreases to about 0.33. The caption indicates that the baseline (before gating) and post-gating values are similar, which is consistent with the visual data showing the post-gating lines (after gate and after average gate) having similar trends and final values.
